sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 245 (Village of Morrisville): section 6(a) provides for five trustees elected at the annual meeting to five-year terms

Morrisville Water & Light (the Village of Morrisville's municipal utility), Trustees page: names the Village's five-member Board of Trustees as Carl Fortune, Thomas Snipp, Travis Knapp, Robert Heanue, and Bradley Limoge
Morrisville Water & Light, About page: states the trustees serve five-year terms and are elected at the annual Village Meeting, and names the same five current trustees

24 App. V.S.A. ch. 245 (Village of Morrisville): section 6(a) provides for a Moderator elected at the annual meeting to a one-year term; no published source located names the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

24 App. V.S.A. ch. 245 (Village of Morrisville): section 6(a) provides for a Clerk elected at the annual meeting to a one-year term; no published source located names the current holder, so the post is created without a membership. The 'Clerk' named beside individual trustees on the utility's pages is clerk of the board of trustees, a different role

24 App. V.S.A. ch. 245 (Village of Morrisville): section 6(a) provides for a Treasurer elected at the annual meeting to a one-year term; no published source located names the current holder, so the post is created without a membership
